title: 第9章 仅你一人第10章 种田养鸡体修突破
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
箫千凝的目光在他身上打量着，看到他还是一身杂役破袍之后皱了皱眉，但是也没说什么。
“这上边的宫殿是九幽峰的祖业，几百年前的九幽峰广开山门核心弟子才能在这宫殿里修行，现在这里是我的居所……以你现在的修为，来九幽峰也只是外门弟子而已，就先在这山脚下你找个地方搭建住所吧。”
“是！”
顾平点头，他也早有此意。
这山腰属实有点高了，他炼气的修为爬这么高的山也需要一点时间。
住在山脚下反而方便出行。
等到自己筑基之后能够御剑上来也是一样，那时候登山就轻松了许多。
看到顾平利索答应，箫千凝拿出一枚巴掌大的令牌。
“这是九幽峰的令牌，你去宗门大殿，办理外门弟子的身份吧，这令牌也可让你自由通行九幽峰法阵。”
“多谢首座。”
箫千凝点头。
一袭素白长袍，如霜雪覆身，清冷中透着一丝孤傲。
偏偏身形纤细修长，腰肢如柳，因常年镇压煞气而带着几分凌厉的挺拔，仿佛一柄出鞘的寒刃，锋芒内敛。
顾平的目光没忍住在她莹白的肌肤上扫过，还有她的锁骨，耳朵，腰肢……
女子怎么可能感受不到他的目光，她眼尾微微上挑，一颦一笑自带三分冷艳色。
“你怎么回事？”
她忽然开口。
“啊？”
顾平一愣，以为自己偷看被发现。
内心有些惴惴不安。

“我说你为何仍旧元阳未失的状态。”
顾平有些疑惑。
现在他有些不知道如何解释了，毕竟昨晚他才和她行事，今天又变成童子男了……
怎么样解释都很奇怪。
“我也有些不清楚。”
他只有实话实说了。
箫千凝也不见怪，只是淡淡开口，“应该是你的体质不错……”
酝酿片刻之后，她还是接着开口，“有机会的话，你可以关注一下这一代的圣女，她是万年难得一见的玄阴体，和你的体质颇为相似，若是有机会和她双修的话……”
顾平当然是使劲摇头。
“首座大人说笑了，弟子哪里敢和其他女修再有瓜葛……”
这话说出来，他看到箫千凝面无表情的时候就立即改口，“首座恕罪，是弟子口不择言了。”
箫千凝没应声，目光定定地看着远处，又回头瞥他一眼。
顾平再一眨眼，她就消失不见了。
“唉，首座大人，九幽峰要大开山门了吗？”
“不开，仅你一人。”
声音袅袅传回来。
顾平松了一口气，和箫千凝待在一起的时候压力真的不小，除非是呆在她里边，才能免除压力。
回到山下之后，他先出了山门，回到坊市去。
content_en:
Xiao Qianning's eyes looked at him, and she frowned when she saw that he was still wearing a handyman's rags, but she didn't say anything.
"The palace above is the ancestral property of Jiuyou Peak. Hundreds of years ago, only the core disciples of Jiuyou Peak's Guangkai Sect could practice in this palace. Now this is my residence... With your current cultivation level, you are only an outer sect disciple when you come to Jiuyou Peak. Just find a place to build a residence at the foot of this mountain first."
"Yes!"
Gu Ping nodded, he had already intended this.
The mountainside is indeed a bit high, and it will take some time for his Qi-refining skills to climb such a high mountain.
Living at the foot of the mountain is convenient for traveling.
The same goes for when you can climb up with a sword after building a foundation. Then climbing the mountain will be much easier.
Seeing Gu Ping's prompt agreement, Xiao Qianning took out a palm-sized token.
"This is the token of Jiuyou Peak. Go to the sect's main hall and register as an outer disciple. This token also allows you to freely pass through the Jiuyou Peak array."
"Thank you, sir."
Xiao Qianning nodded.
Wearing a plain white robe, covered like frost and snow, there is a hint of aloofness in the coldness.
However, his figure is slender and slender, his waist is like a willow, and he has a sharp uprightness due to suppressing evil spirits all the year round, like a cold blade unsheathed, with a restrained edge.
Gu Ping's eyes couldn't help but scan her fair skin, as well as her collarbones, ears, waist...
How could the woman not feel his gaze? The ends of her eyes were slightly raised, and her every frown and smile had a hint of coolness.
"What's wrong with you?"
She suddenly spoke.
"Huh?"
Gu Ping was stunned for a moment, thinking that he had been caught peeking.
I felt a little uneasy inside.
"I asked you why you are still in a state where Yuanyang has not been lost."
Gu Ping was a little confused.
Now he doesn't know how to explain it. After all, he just acted with her last night, and today he became a boy again...
It's weird no matter how you explain it.
"I'm a little unclear too."
He only told the truth.
Xiao Qianning was not surprised and just said calmly, "It should be because you have a good physique..."
After pondering for a moment, she continued, "If you have the chance, you can pay attention to this generation of saints. She has a mysterious yin body that is rare in ten thousand years. Her physique is quite similar to yours. If you have the opportunity to practice double cultivation with her..."
Of course Gu Ping shook his head vigorously.
"The First Master is joking, how dare this disciple have anything to do with other female cultivators..."
When he said this, he immediately changed his words when he saw Xiao Qianning's expressionless face, "My Lord, please forgive me, it's my disciple who kept his mouth shut."
Xiao Qianning didn't respond, looking steadily into the distance, then glanced back at him.
Gu Ping blinked again and she disappeared.
"Hey, sir, is Jiuyou Peak going to open its gate?"
"No, it's just you."
The voice came back softly.
Gu Ping breathed a sigh of relief. The pressure was really high when he was with Xiao Qianning. Only by staying with her could he avoid the pressure.
After returning to the foot of the mountain, he went out of the mountain gate first and returned to Fangshi.
